hero.title: Quiz Platform for Companies
hero.text: A modern platform where companies can create quizzes, manage employees, and improve learning through interactive assessments and progress tracking.

feature1.title: Company Quizzes
feature1.text: Companies can create quizzes for onboarding, education, certification, and employee evaluation.

feature2.title: Team Collaboration
feature2.text: Invite employees, manage members, and organize learning inside your company workspace.

feature3.title: Interactive Learning
feature3.text: Users can complete quizzes, improve their knowledge, and track their progress.

feature4.title: Performance Tracking
feature4.text: Monitor quiz results and evaluate user performance through detailed statistics.
